load_model_from_hub: load a DINOv3 or DINOv2 model from torch.hub using a ModelConfig with dino_hub set
load_model_from_config: load a DINOv3 model from a local config file and pretrained weights via load_model_and_context
setup_and_build_model: setup and build a DINOv3 model for evaluation from a config file with optional pretrained weights
get_autocast_dtype: get the autocast dtype from a DINOv3 config by checking compute_precision param_dtype setting
create_model_config: create a ModelConfig dataclass to specify config file, pretrained weights, or torch.hub model name
